messages.subject: Mining & Resources Executive | ESG, Government Relations & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Matthews,

Accurate Talent Solutions' work across mining and resources leadership in Africa and international markets makes this a focused introduction.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with responsibility spanning government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications.

I am pursuing Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership mandates where mining growth, regulatory execution, institutional relationships, stakeholder confidence and responsible development must be managed together. I am internationally mobile and open to expatriate appointments across the GCC, Africa and broader global resources markets.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration for relevant current or future mandates.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department
AGM Inc. | Zijin Mining Group
Georgetown, Guyana
